title: The code is no longer the hard part. The concept is.
intro: AI writes production code. It can’t decide what should exist, why, or what “right” looks like. That’s the product owner’s job — and at 2code4 it never gets delegated.

steps.title: Understand the problem
steps.body: Most software fails at the concept, not the code. Every project starts with the real need — who uses it, where, and what has to change.

steps.title: Shape the concept
steps.body: Flows, screens, priorities and what to leave out — prototyped with AI under close direction, and clicked through before any production code exists.

steps.title: Prompt the build
steps.body: The product owner writes the brief; Claude Code writes the code — apps, sites, webshops, firmware and dashboards, from one seat.

steer.label: 04 · Runs through every step
steer.title: Check and decide
steer.body: Vibecoding without steering is just vibes. Every output is reviewed — architecture, edge cases, fit with the concept. AI proposes; the product owner decides what ships.

evolve.label: 05 · And then again
evolve.title: Live is a milestone, not the finish
evolve.body: A product goes live early and keeps evolving. Each iteration is a short, agile sprint through the same loop — concept, prompt, check, decide — driven by what real users do.

releases.title: First release
releases.body: The core that proves the concept, live with real users.

releases.title: Sprints
releases.body: Fixes, polish and the features users ask for.
